question: Third-year student is studying contracts. He has learned that generally all contractual rights may be assigned, but there are some exceptions. Which of the following is not an exception?

options.A: An assignment that substantially changes obligor's duty or risk.
options.B: An assignment that changes the nature of the contract.
options.C: An assignment that continues the obligor's duty or risk.
options.D: An assignment that transfers rights to an incapable party.
options.E: An assignment that causes undue hardship or loss to the obligor.
options.F: An assignment that reduces the value of the contract to the obligor.
options.G: An assignment of future rights from future contracts.
options.H: An assignment that is made without the consent of the other party.
options.I: An assignment not allowed by law.
